Visible history lengths span 3..20 items. All 30 encoder slots remain plotted, with exactly zero masked attention and a separate visibility band; pad regions are not evidence of row similarity.

The 21 nonzero final-ancestor samples make the distinction from local-first real: only 11 of 32 complete displayed pairs are exactly equal. Local-first remains an independent prefix choice at each step.
